name: CHiME-6 Corpus: Dinner Party Conversational Speech Recognition Benchmark
description: CHiME-6 is a conversational speech recognition benchmark dataset recorded during unconstrained dinner party gatherings in real homes. Evolving from CHiME-5 to address clock-drift and array synchronization across binaural and multi-channel arrays, it captures 20 multi-speaker sessions totaling 50 hours of audio across binaural and 4-channel microphone arrays.
